text: Court watch: the house is not protected homestead (the decedent lived elsewhere), and there is no will with a power of sale. The PR needs court authorization (s. 733.613(1)).
The contract uses the court-authorization contingency instead of the homestead one; closing 10 days after the order.

Court watch: Order Authorizing Sale entered. Florida doesn't hold an overbid auction for this; in confirmation-and-overbid states (e.g. Ohio, Pennsylvania), the Negotiator tells the buyer of the overbid risk and the Transaction Coordinator tracks the hearing.
